components.name: Scene
components.description: Mounts one validated spatial scene with a semantic canvas and static fallback.

props.label: accessible canvas label
props.quality: low, medium, or high performance budget

props.src: public model URL or asset path

components.name: Camera
components.description: Declares a camera node inside a Scene using stable authoring props.

components.name: Light
components.description: Declares an ambient, directional, or point light node inside a Scene.

components.name: Environment
components.description: Declares a scene environment background or optional environment asset source.

components.name: ProceduralModel
components.description: References an editable TypeScript procedural model factory, including img2threejs-style output.

props.src: factory module URL or asset path

components.name: Story
components.description: Renders semantic chapters and publishes deterministic native-scroll progress events.

props.chapters: array of id, title, body, and optional scrollWeight objects
